user.title: HouseLit
user.description:
This turns on HouseLit. Next, open the **HouseLit** app on your iPhone and sign in. Or open **HouseLit** in the sidebar and follow the steps there. On the old 3.0 app (then called Wrist Assistant), sign in to Home Assistant from the iPhone app instead.

[Setup guide]({docs_url})

abort.single_instance_allowed: HouseLit is already set up. To add a device, open the HouseLit app on your iPhone and sign in. Or open HouseLit in the sidebar and follow the steps there.
